Players Committee card image of [[R2-D2 (Artoo-Detoo) (V) (ALT) (Errata)]] (errata PC-E1), game text: “While aboard a starfighter, adds 2 to power, maneuver, and hyperspeed. While present with a Scomp link, adds one [Light Side] icon here. Immune to Fire Extinguisher and Restraining Bolt.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/large/r2d2_ai.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/509151e2a81ba946389cdd7b3468137a459c5ad5 509151e] (2 December 2023). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged (the repository file is named .gif but is PNG data, so it is uploaded with a .png name).
